name: EMU PARK | PATHWAY - grass [BUMPY]
description:
Lions Bell Park, Hill St, EMU PARK

The LIONS BELL PARK MARKETS are a great place to visit THIRD SUNDAY of every month 8am-12pm. But the park is bumpy so hold on to your wheelie-walker and don't expect a comfortable ride in a manual wheelchair. There is NO disability toilet within 700m (Emu Park Beach is the nearest one) and it is OLD.
